author: Randall_89
quote:
After years of waiting, GTA VI is a disappointment, both technically and in its very essence. It is capped at an unstable 30 FPS, with constant frame-rate drops in densely populated areas and an alarming number of bugs that break missions—bugs that occur far more frequently than one would expect.Motorcycle handling feels rigid and unrealistic; the ability to purchase properties for progression has been removed; and missions remain excessively linear, punishing any attempt at creative freedom ; a step backward compared to previous entries.Ultimately, the game has lost its identity. The weapon mechanics are poor. Missions cannot be replayed. You cannot cause chaos without facing long-term consequences. Classic minigames and activities are entirely absent.
The biting satire and dark humor that defined the series have been replaced by a lackluster script, aligned with a progressive agenda that has stripped away all of its rebellious spirit.This is a different game; it’s not a GTA.
